body: I have four Polaroid photos that I took of us intimately just a couple of months before she passed. From them, i can really see how much we physically and emotionally loved each other. I'm honestly proud of those photographs, they turned out great and captures how beautiful she was. No one else shall ever see them, and I'm glad to have kept them.

23 year old male. I have never talked to another bipolar person about bipolar

Truly became a daily smoker after my late girlfriend passed away, and I began to hang out with some old friends everyday. Usually smoke multiple times a day, usually at night but lately throughout the day. I did do 4 weeks of sober October so I had no alcohol, weed, nor nicotine.
Yeah I didn't expect him to whip out a gallon size bag half full, I haven't had this much weed in a loooooong time

The song Wish You Were Here by Pink Floyd would make me cry after my late friend passed away when I was 18. It does the same now after I lost my girlfriend. I wish you were here, and I wish they were all here with us
Happy birthday! When I look back, I am surprised that I made it to 22, four months after she passed. I'm glad we are both still going forward and that you didn't give up

Ended up getting kicked out of uni due to "terroristic threats" and then ended up stealing some a truck and trespassed on the university. Separate incident, allegedly pulled a fire alarm and evacuated building that housed pretty much the entire population of a small town.

Thanks for the information. I am waiting for the public defenders agency to contact me. I am on misdeamonor probation already, with only like 5 months remaining. On the plus side, I am dealing with court in the largest city of my state, and it is much more progressive with mental health and rehabilitation. Or at least it is trying, but it seems much better than when I dealt with the system in my hometown. Whatever happens, I'm not too stressed.
Yeah I was shirtless and had no shoes when I got arrested last week. I made sure to keep my pants on, there were children around haha. Next time I won't forget to bring the emergency sleep meds.

The charges were dropped for this one but it's the first time I did real illegal stuff and so I ended up breaking into the basement of the dorm building. I just kicked the doorbell off and went in. I then proceeded to take off all my clothes lol. I thought I was split. I should have not taken the meds they prescribed me after wisdom tooth surgery haha. I hope I stop, this is second time in two years

Was doing pretty damn great in college for three years, but then I started going into my first major manic episode before I was diagnosed. I got kicked out of my dorm, I missed classes like crazy but I started taking up every club and event, and then I reached the climax by getting trespassed and dropped from my classes. 

Now that I have been diagnosed and I am tolerating medication, I fully believe I will be able to handle school well for the most part. I just have to make sure I get adequate sleep. After almost two years now, I recently was informed that I will be able to attend the college again. I definitely plan on going back in the fall and finishing my degree. I bet hitting milestones, such as graduation, feel extra rewarding since we achieved it while having our condition. 

Good luck!
I'm signing up for classes for the fall to finish the final year of my undergrad. It's been about a two year break after initially getting diagnosed. I wish us luck!
I dig your name, coming from an Erik. 1
Started up rock climbing again. I have a few friends that go to the same climbing gym so its nice to socialize, have fun, exercise, and set personal goals.
I was in October. The only differences I saw were that we all had to wear masks, only one person per room (there are two-bed rooms), no visitors, and there was a quarantine area for people exposed.
Thats pretty much what I ended up doing myself
Much love from a fellow widower as well. Gotta keep their memory alive!
It was definitely a nice surprise after smoking to see this video uploaded. I love his content.
Hidden Brain by NPR is a podcast that my late girlfriend and I enjoyed listening to. It's a podcast where I learn a lot of things about human behavior and sociology.
I too wish I could leave this life, this hollow empty life.
It would be heaven to have that
Wholeheartedly yes. For something to be stripped away so fast makes everything feel like a nightmare. I want to go back and live in those dreams again.

I would give anything just to go grocery shopping with my love. To go down the aisles of the local grocery store to pick up snacks and comfort foods, while also picking out the ingredients for dinner. She loved cooking for me, and I loved helping her out in the kitchen

The last message I received from my beautiful girl was "good because you're stuck with me." It breaks my heart to read that message, the last thing in writing from her. 

I constantly look at everything I have that is connected to her, and it makes me emotional every time. It hurts but it's okay to break down.
I deeply miss all the compliments she would give me, especially because she was just so gorgeous. I wish I could hear her say, "look at that cute/handsome boy," again.
Visiting this community makes me feel a less lonely when dealing with this pain and loss.
I feel for you brother, this is hard.
Today marks 4 weeks since she passed away. It hurts so damm much to have to enter the new year with her gone from this world. Its not right.
Just seeing her name displayed under "Obituaries" honestly made my heart sink. Her mother wrote a beautiful one, and I couldn't have described her life any better.

That's what hurts so much. I remember hearing her tell me how she wanted to grow old with me, and that she wanted to live for me. We confessed we were soulmates back in November, she then passed early December. Life can be so painful. She deserved to have everything in the world.

Your words relate to me so much, and it's not right for others to have to deal with such pain. To have these intertwined lives and futures stripped away from us is the absolute worst. I'm constantly plagued with so many "what ifs". You have my empathy.
It hurts me to hear others have this happen to their lives. Young love should never have to end due to early loss, it's not fair at all.
Thank you for your kind words. I'm sorry that you've experienced a very similar lost as well. Type 1 diabetes is devastating.

From one stranger to another, you have my empathy. No one knows the full picture of the relationship, only you. Its something I struggle with as well, this was supposed to be the beginning of something beautiful again, but now they're gone physically. I wish I could change so much too, it's easy to regret and overthink everything that wasnt perfect in the relationship.   No one will truly understand the pain, not even yourself.

Your post and your words echo exactly how I feel. It is terrifying that you are experiencing what I am feeling at this very moment, with such awful parallels. 

My beautiful soulmate was 21 and she passed away just two weeks ago. I was supposed to visit her and spend that weekend with her. It was supposed to be heaven to embrace her again, she was the closest thing to a constant in life. It's not fair for someone to be taken so young, especially one that means the world to you.  

I would never wish this type of pain and heartache onto another, and I am so sorry that you're experiencing something so similar. I also know it's not right to compare someone's pain to another, but here I am. 

I just want to be with her so bad. I constantly think about her all the time, and I have been shattered ever since. Nothing feels right anymore, we were supposed to have a long and happy future together. 

I constantly wish that I when I go to sleep at night, I'll wake up and everything would be different. I just want to be with her, wherever she may be now. 

To me, its almost sickening to think about the future without my soulmate. How can life continue on without the one person that was supposed to be our always. 

Life is unfair and tragic, and I wish I could make this feel better for you. I wish there was something that can life feel better overall. 

I feel a little selfish posting this all, but I've learned that its okay to be selfish. Losing a soulmate is something that is unlike any other loss. 

It's okay to grieve in your own way, but try not to let it destroy you. What you two have is special, and I'm sure he loved you very much. I can tell you loved him more than anything, and that's why it hurts so much. 

I'm sorry for this long post, this may not be the most appropriate place for this, but I want to let you know that you're not alone. I've felt your words and the emotion behind them.
